title: Unit 4 Consolidation
goal: Review articles, ser and adjective agreement while retrieving key language from Units 1–3.

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can use articles with familiar nouns.
I can use ser to give basic information and descriptions.
I can make familiar adjectives agree with the people or nouns they describe.
